exact_statement: For every regular Boolean h on q distinct private data bits and every finite list of arbitrary degree-at-most-two F2 control polynomials Q_i on m independent uniform bits, F(x,z)=h(x_i*(-1)^Q_i(z)) satisfies H(F)<=C_reg*I_x(F)+2*I_z(F)<=C_reg*I(F), C_reg=log2(4+e)+2log2(e*pi)<8.937; moreover H(F)<=C_reg*D_x(F)+2*I_z(F). Its data-indexed spectral packets have exact probabilities hhat(S)^2*2^(-rank B_S) on the affine Fourier support of the quadratic phase sum_i_in_S Q_i, and a normalized rank reference pays all packet ranks. For every odd q>=5, the nonlinear cyclic controlled-majority family has I_x=q*c_q, I_z=3*q*c_q/4 and H/I<=(4*C_reg+6)/7, while it is non-unate and selector influence per control tends to zero.

each Q_i has F2 degree at most two; controls may overlap arbitrarily
